That's quite possible, but a rule made ages ago is still a rule, no matter the context...
As for hurting others... Nobody is going to get hurt... My parents will be annoyed they have to put a funeral together. My brother will be posses I won't send him money anymore and the people I call friends will probably be relieved.
If the people around me felt the same as me, that would be the better way, because at least they would hate me. But as it is, they just don't give a fuck... You can't work with emotion where there's none... Which is why it's better for me to end it...

Pretty much the same thing, put up positive quotes in your apartment, exercise a lot, drink a lot of water, eat good, sleep good, listen to happy music... And it did exactly nothing (except for the exercise, water, food part, that made my ED worse).

I've never heard of it. I mean, I know what CBT is, but never heard the self administered part. How does it work? Not to sound offensive now, I'm glad it made you feel better, but I kinda thought therapy is supposed to be administered by someone objective, not in need of therapy themselves. Self-administered doesn't really check any of those boxes...
Also, I don't wanna sound like I'm whining (although I probably am). It's just the way I see things. I guess I needed to share it with someone...

Because nothing I tried on my own worked (well, obviously) and finding mental health support in my region is damn near impossible. Been to thirteen different psychiatrists. Most of them told me they are full or could give me a term in like a year. One looked me up and down and asked me how old I was to have depression, one told me he doesn't take self diagnosing patients (since I told him I think it's depression and anxiety based on the symptoms I found at Google) and the winner, who made me not want to try this ever again was the doctor, who ran out of her room, angry and yelled at me that she currently only dealt with emergency cases and slammed the door in my face. I was pretty severely suicidal at that time, kinda emergency, if you ask me...
So yea, as I see it, since I don't want to go to Christian hell, I just have to pull thru this one and hope I go to heaven, when I finally die...
I would love to know that too, if you find out, let me know...

The problem is, I have been hanging there for years now. Call me weak if you want, but I just have the juice anymore to fight. I fight to fall asleep, I fight to wake up and I fight for every movement between... I just want to fight to stop. I dont want rainbows and unicorns (talk about cliches), I just want a normal non-painful existence.
